title: Connect layers in order
summary: A later layer uses the earlier layer outputs as its inputs. Deep networks have several layers that transform information step by step.
introduction: A later layer uses the earlier layer outputs as its inputs. Deep networks have several layers that transform information step by step. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A later layer uses the earlier layer outputs as its inputs. Deep networks have several layers that transform information step by step.
The output is 3.5. The first hidden value contributes 3.5, and the second contributes zero. This is a chosen calculation, not a trained prediction.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.text: Without suitable activations, stacking plain linear layers still gives one overall linear rule.
